R-hierarchy.reason: The Settings controls lead cleanly with grouped section headings, clear segmented rows, and one prominent 'Back up now' primary button, while live preview cards stay secondary in a supporting pane on tablet and desktop.

R-fill.reason: Only the primary 'Back up now' filled button uses a strong saturated fill, while rows, cards, and supporting panes stay in calm neutral container tones with small matching switch and slider accents.

R-surfaces.reason: Tonal separation between the surface backdrop, surfaceContainerLow preview pane, surfaceContainerHigh segmented rows/cards, and surfaceContainerHighest icon badges clearly groups content without competing fills.

R-controls.reason: The top bar back button, connected theme toggle buttons, row switches, text size slider, and 'Back up now' button each look distinct and clearly tappable.

R-font.reason: Bundled Fraunces bold gives an intentional editorial voice to the 'Settings' top bar title and titleLarge headings ('Live preview & sync', 'Morning field notes'), while body/labels stay Google Sans Flex and Google Sans Code carries tabular numbers and metadata.

R-platform.reason: The screens follow Android conventions with edge-to-edge Scaffold surfaces, a back arrow icon instead of iOS Cancel/Done text buttons, and no disclosure chevrons on list rows.

R-text.reason: All titles, supporting labels, slider values, and card metrics render cleanly without clipping, truncation, or overlap across all five screenshots.

R-dark.reason: In settings-dark.png, all text, top bar and leading badge icons, connected toggle buttons, switches, and the mint 'Back up now' button maintain high legibility against dark surfaces.

R-adaptive.reason: While tablet and desktop adapt into a two-pane layout with the 'Live preview & sync' inspector, settings-foldable.png renders a centered 420dp phone-width column with roughly 142dp empty margins on both sides misaligned with the left-aligned top app bar, pushing 'Last synced' and 'Back up now' below the fold.

R-idea.reason: The 'Editorial Ink' direction pairs Fraunces headings, Google Sans Code metadata, ink-green segmented settings groups, and a live Note Preview, Notification Schedule, and Cloud Vault wavy-progress inspector tailored to Jot.

R-semantics.reason: All section headings carry Modifier.semantics { heading() }, and every toggle row uses SegmentedListItem(onClick = onToggle) with Role.Switch and toggleableState while passing onCheckedChange = null to Switch.

R-fields.reason: The proposal contains no text input or search field composables.

R-visibility.reason: Conditional layout branches use Kotlin if statements around composables and never hide content in composition via zero alpha.

R-blur.reason: No Modifier.blur is used anywhere in the proposal.

R-settings-platform.reason: Omitted account management, version, and license rows per the brief, uses switches for on/off settings, a connected FilledTonalToggleButton group for theme selection, and section headings over grouped segmented rows.
